units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 3:7:11">Y. Peah III, 17ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>יש לו מ׳</he> he has left for himself something to live on (a permanent source of income). Sifré Num. 159; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 787:12">Yalk. Num. 787</cite> <he>שווקים ובית המ׳</he> markets and a provision store (v. <cite ref="H00692"><he>חֵיוְתָא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:1:2">Y. Pes. VII, 34ᵃ</cite> bot., expl. <cite ref="M00880"><he>מִחְיַת</he></cite> (<cite ref="Leviticus 13:24">Lev. XIII, 24</cite>) <he>חייתה ולא חייתה</he> it is and is not healed up (has only a thin covering).
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:5">Neg. I, 5</cite>. Sifra Thazr., <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 2">Neg., ch. II, Par. 2</cite> <he>מִחְיָתָהּ כגריס</he> if the half-healed part of it is as large as a bean.
